content:
sam.t: Hey team, kickoff for NutraHealth POC — need to lock use cases, success metrics, timeline, and security asks. @alex can you confirm an SE for next week? POC focus: ingest support KB -> retrieval -> personalized customer-facing summaries.

alex: I can cover SE on Mon/Tue next week. Quick Q: do they want hosted or dedicated initially?

sam.t: They said they'd prefer hosted to start but might move to dedicated if throughput/latency or data controls demand it. Main goals to scope: 1) Replace canned KB answers with concise LLM summaries, 2) Personalization using user profile, 3) Live support snippets with low latency.

maria: For the POC we should define for each use case: user journey, API endpoints, example prompts, eval dataset, success thresholds, infra/security requirements (VPC, KMS, retention).

jamie: Prioritization suggestion: 1) RAG QA (highest value), 2) Personalized summaries, 3) Suggestion/recommendation snippets (lower priority).

olivia: Security checklist: we'll need their completed security questionnaire, data residency requirement, retention policy, KMS/HSM needs, SOC2/ISO status, and pen-test dates. Can they share a network/dataflow diagram?

sam.t: I'll ask them for the questionnaire and sample transcripts. Also attaching (inline) a starter prompt set + eval plan — feel free to edit. Need also a pricing recommendation path: hosted vs dedicated vs private.

alex: Two asks from infra side: estimated monthly token volume (drives cost) and target latency SLO (e.g., P95 <=250ms) — confirm both with customer.

maria: Draft example prompts to include in the POC: 
```
User: "I can't access my order #1234, what's going on?"
System: "Use account id + last orders to summarize likely reason, required next step, and suggested KB link."
```
Eval metrics proposeds: relevance (nDCG@5), hallucination rate, answer completeness (human 1-5).

jamie: Eval harness plan: 200 anonymized support threads, 3 human raters per item, rubric: helpfulness 1-5, factuality binary for critical facts. Passing criteria = avg helpfulness >=4 and hallucination <2%.

olivia: Security note: for Dedicated/Private we'll require customer KMS integration, SSO (SAML/OIDC), audit logs export, and a retained data delete workflow. I'll send our standard checklist via email.

sam.t: Proposed timeline: Week 0: kickoffs + data share; Week 1: seed evals + baseline runs; Week 2: tuning + UAT; Week 3: customer demo + success review. Is that realistic? :calendar:

alex: Realistic if customer can provide 2k anonymized support transcripts and API access to KB by Friday of Week 0. Also need sample user profile schema.

maria: API endpoints to prototype: POST /v1/retrieve -> returns top-k docs, POST /v1/generate-summary -> returns structured summary, POST /v1/profile-query -> returns profile attributes for personalization. Model suggestion: start with a high-quality open checkpoint quantized for latency; enable a smaller fallback model for cold starts.

jamie: Success criteria (compact): P95 latency <=250ms for generation, relevance nDCG@5 >=0.85, hallucination rate <2%, human helpfulness avg >=4/5, and cost target (hosted) <= $0.30 per 1k tokens OR consider Dedicated commit if monthly spend > their threshold.

olivia: I'll require a completed security questionnaire and data flow diagram before we send any production-like data. Also need a contact for legal to loop on DPA.

sam.t: OK I'll coordinate asks with the customer and set a scoping call Mon 10am PT. @alex @maria @jamie pls mark availability. I'll post the repo link and seed data once they send the transcript bundle. Thanks! :thumbsup:
